Sets device parameter.

## Synopsis

```text
setdevice [storage=<storage>] [device=<device>] [autoselect=<yes|no>]
```

Words without brackets are required, `[ ]` marks optional parts, `a | b` alternatives, `...` a repeatable argument and `[,...]` a comma separated list.

## Description

Changes the Auto Select setting of a device in the Storage Daemon at run time. With autoselect=no the Storage Daemon no longer picks the device for jobs, for example during maintenance; with autoselect=yes it is available again. The state lasts until the Storage Daemon restarts; configuration and catalog are not touched.

storage=, device= and autoselect= are all required, in any order, and the keywords must be lower case; no other arguments are allowed. A console restricted to certain storages may only change their devices.

## Arguments {#arguments}

| Argument | Type | Values / source | Default | Flags | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `storage=` | resource | from [`.storages`](../dot-storage/) |  |  | Storage name. |
| `device=` | string |  |  |  | Device name. |
| `autoselect=` | bool | `yes`, `no` |  |  | Autoselect flag. |

## Examples

Keep jobs away from Drive-1 during maintenance:

```text
setdevice storage=Tape device=Drive-1 autoselect=no
```

Make the drive available again:

```text
setdevice storage=Tape device=Drive-1 autoselect=yes
```
